reassignments.rationale: The nine #191 controls the pinned reference rejects (reference-collected in tests/oracle/webp-container, including libwebp's VP8X valid-flag mask) recover exactly as a missing asset in SVG/PNG/PDF, with exact reports, extents and replay. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

The three #191 controls the pinned reference accepts (libwebp skips reserved VP8X bytes, ignores reserved ANMF bits and takes a frame's size from its bitstream) draw exactly like their base in PNG/PDF and keep their octets in SVG. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

owners.rationale: WebP orientation facet: EXIF orientation 0-9, prefixed, flag-clear and garbage EXIF over lossless, lossy, alpha and animated bases are never applied, matching the reference exactly in all formats (52 reference rows). See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP color-profile facet: v2/v4 matrix, LUT and Lab-LUT RGB profiles apply only to a still image with the ICC flag set; gray, CMYK, Lab-model and unparseable profiles, a clear flag, a missing chunk and animations are ignored; sRGB-equivalent profiles snap to sRGB as Skia does; duplicate, trailing and oversized profiles follow the demuxer (50 reference rows, 34 approved exact-ceiling small-artifact exceptions), with the untagged VP8/VP8L sample matrix. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP malformed facet: container faults the reference rejects recover exactly; faults its demuxer tolerates (trailing bytes, reserved bytes and frame bits, missing and unknown chunks, oversized metadata) draw like their base; 48 reference container rows plus the 12 reference-collected #191 controls and their owners. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP passthrough facet: direct SVG embeds the exact source octets of every admitted row of the 195-row record, whatever its metadata, trailing bytes or unknown chunks, and rejects what the reference rejects. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP alpha facet: the VP8X alpha flag against the bitstream's alpha (Blink's straight-as-premultiplied buffer, ignored lossy ALPH), exact PDF alpha, and the sample matrix's opaque, binary and partial alpha, soft mask, transparent RGB zero, draw-time truncation and approved #191 PDF exceptions. One flag-clear plus transforming-ICC row is a pinned divergence (#197). See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP default-frame and animation facets: every frame validates; the first frame draws on a transparent canvas for three and five frames, reserved frame bits, either alpha flag, EXIF and duplicate ANIM; PNG/PDF report one informational flattening and SVG keeps the animation; with the 60-vector sample animation matrix. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.

WebP limits facet: byte, dimension, pixel and work equality and exact first crossing (the attempted total) for lossless, lossy and animated WebP in every format with exact reports and recovery, and the spec 13.2 multi-crossing precedence. See docs/research/webp-umbrella-facets.md.
